chapter: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band
title: Bassist Louis Thompson's career after the band
summary: Louis Thompson, an early member who played bass with Louis Depp's band when Earl Hines was in it, now lives in New Jersey and works for a distiller.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I've been Jonah ever since. But it was a great band. And it got to do little things like, you know, little mischief things, like the bass player, and I was having fun with him. I was telling him about it. We were reminiscing not too long ago, a very nice guy, he lives over in Jersey, but he's been in another business. He played with Louis Depps' band way back when Earl Hines was with him.
Yeah, years ago. He was one of the first out of the band, you know.

Yeah, played with Depp and somebody else. I can't think who the other -- somebody else's band, and probably a couple of others, but he was out in front of us, so we didn't know where he was. But he lives over in Jersey. He's been working for one of the distillers, Brown and Forman Distillers, out of Kentucky, but he lives in Jersey, has his
own home there. And he don't play anything now, but he was a wonderful bass horn player. Played the double-B, too, didn't play E-Flat.
